name: Death Star
summary: **Death Star** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] commonly described as a cross of [[sensi-star|Sensi Star]] and [[sour-diesel|Sour Diesel]] that appeared in the US cannabis market around 2001. Its original breeder is not documented, and some growers dispute the standard parentage, describing instead a hermaphrodite Sour Diesel pollinating a plant known as Ogre.

sources.title: The Real Genetics Of Death Star
